::: {.callout-note title="How it works"}
Choose (1) the semester you want to plan, (2) your semester in DH, (3) Major or Minor and (4), for the Major, your specialisation. Filter the course list and **add** courses: they appear in the weekly calendar. Overlapping sessions are marked in red; courses that are planned for a later semester or do not count for your programme are flagged. Your selection is kept in this browser only. **This planner is a help, not a registration** – book your courses in [KSL](https://www.ksl.unibe.ch/KSL/home), and check the [programme page](../index.qmd) and the study plan.
:::


## Notes

- **Data:** spring 2027 from KSL and the [semester overview](../fs2027/index.qmd) (as of 12 November 2026); autumn 2027 is [in development](../hs2027/index.qmd) and based on the autumn 2026 timetable. Courses without fixed dates are listed but not shown in the calendar.
- **Checks:** overlaps are computed for every single date (holidays and the Easter break are left out). A course is flagged as *too early* when the study plan places its block in a later semester; elective seminars are only noted, as they can be taken earlier. PPP and Project Management workshops are never flagged: start them early, ideally with *Introduction to Project Management* in your first autumn semester.
- **Specialisations:** seminars are tagged with the specialisations they fit; colloquia and courses without a tag are general. Seminars of your specialisation are marked green.
- Questions: Adrian Demleitner, head of study programmes ([adrian.demleitner@unibe.ch](mailto:adrian.demleitner@unibe.ch)).
